**Indikator 6** is a quality indicator managed by the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] that measures the proportion of treatment pathways where patients with ADHD receive pharmacological treatment [^src1]. Unlike other indicators in the database, Indikator 6 was initially established without a fixed standard or development target, meaning its high values reflect medical treatment practices rather than a direct quality benchmark [^src1]. It was officially put into operation on May 25, 2021 [^src2].

The indicator tracks patients within the [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]] whose package pathway started during the reporting period [^src2]. It specifically includes the prescription of several medications, such as [[dexamfetamin-n06ba02|Dexamfetamin (N06BA02)]], [[methylphenidat-n06ba04|Methylphenidat (N06BA04)]], [[modafinil-n06ba07|Modafinil (N06BA07)]], [[atomoxetin-n06ba09|Atomoxetin (N06BA09)]], [[lisdexamfetamin-n06ba12|Lisdexamfetamin (N06BA12)]], and [[guanfacin-c02ac02|Guanfacin (C02AC02)]] [^src2].

During the 2023–2024 reporting period (April 1, 2023, to March 31, 2024), the national average for Indikator 6 was 62% [^src1]. By the subsequent 2024–2025 reporting period, the national average had risen to 68% [^src4]. Although earlier reports noted that the indicator lacked a development target [^src4], later documentation from the 2024 report indicates that a development target of ≥ 90% was established for the 2024–2025 period [^src5]. The [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] has noted that while pharmacological treatment rates are relatively strong, non-pharmacological interventions remain crucial for the quality of ADHD treatment [^src5].

Regional and local variations in medication rates are significant. For the 2024–2025 period, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] recorded the highest regional medication rate at 82%, followed by [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] at 72% [^src5]. At the clinic level, [[bornholm-bup-ambulatorium|Bornholm: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] achieved the highest rate among noted clinics at 86%, while [[hillerod-psykiatrisk-ambulatorium-boern-og-unge|Hillerød: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] reached 69%, [[glostrup-bup-ambulatorium|Glostrup: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] reached 68%, and [[bispebjerg-bup-ambulatorium|Bispebjerg: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] recorded 61% [^src5].

## Timeline
- **2021-05-25:** Indikator 6 blev sat i drift (indikator-6) [^src2]
- **2023-04-01:** Start af opgørelsesperioden for Indikator 6 og 7a/7b i årsrapport 2023/24 (indikator-6, indikator-7a, indikator-7b) [^src2]
- **2024-03-31:** Afslutning af opgørelsesperioden for Indikator 6 og 7a/7b i årsrapport 2023/24 (indikator-6, indikator-7a, indikator-7b) [^src2]
- **01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025:** Opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 5 og Indikator 6 med udviklingsmål på ≥ 90 % (indikator-5, indikator-6) [^src5]
